title: data for nudge.raise
description: The board's own task supervisor (J-05, src/supervisor.mjs) files one nudge: a feedback record of kind nudge to the owning lane (level 1), CoS (2) or the owner (3), or a daily digest (rule digest, target *, info). Written only by the board itself: no role may send it.

key.description: Dedup key: a key the board has filed once is never filed again.

ask_ids.description: R2: the asks one owner nudge lists (it closes when none is open).

also_keys.description: R2: the per-ask keys this nudge covers (each ask once per ownerAskMs).
